dimensions.name: day_name
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN day_of_week = 0 THEN 'Sun'
  WHEN day_of_week = 1 THEN 'Mon'
  WHEN day_of_week = 2 THEN 'Tue'
  WHEN day_of_week = 3 THEN 'Wed'
  WHEN day_of_week = 4 THEN 'Thu'
  WHEN day_of_week = 5 THEN 'Fri'
  WHEN day_of_week = 6 THEN 'Sat'
END

dimensions.name: weekend_flag
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_weekend = 1 THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END

dimensions.name: cross_city_flag
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_cross_city_tx = 1 THEN 'Cross-City' ELSE 'Same City' END

dimensions.name: fraud_status
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_fraud = 1 THEN 'Fraud' ELSE 'Legitimate' END

dimensions.name: fraud_status
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_fraud = 1 THEN 'Fraud' ELSE 'Legitimate' END

dimensions.name: online_status
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_online = 1 THEN 'Online' ELSE 'Offline' END

dimensions.name: age_group
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN age < 25 THEN '18-24'
  WHEN age < 35 THEN '25-34'
  WHEN age < 45 THEN '35-44'
  WHEN age < 55 THEN '45-54'
  ELSE '55+'
END

dimensions.name: identity_status
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN identity_verified = 1 THEN 'Verified' ELSE 'Unverified' END
